None is resolved or attributed to a patient.

Table 2 footnote: the +/yes, -/no legend is given only for the illicit drug history column, the alcohol column is labelled H in the footnote and HA in the header, and SAU has no legend; alcohol and SAU facts are review-only.
GKS is not defined in the Table 2 footnote; Results report eight patients with GCS below 15 and the GKS column has eight values below 15, a count match only, so the label is kept as printed.
The analytical method is stated as HR LC-MS/MS in the abstract and Methods but as the immunoassay method in the Discussion; no method is assigned to the per-patient substance results.
The Discussion says five patients received 5 mg intravenous haloperidol because of acute psychotic symptoms; the indication is not attributed to individual Table 2 rows (attribute match only).
CT is described as time of consciousness (h) in the Table 2 footnote and as time to regain consciousness in Methods and Table 1; kept as printed.
The SC Type column lists substances determined (including mephedrone metabolites and Ketiapin); specimen type per patient is not stated; diagnosis of SC intoxication kept provisional.
One Discussion sentence reports a patient who died of respiratory problems without naming the case; Table 2 case 8 records death; the cause is review-only on p8.
Table 2 case 8 treatment cell contains printed oddities (midazolam; 2 mg IV; fentanyl 50 mg IV) kept as printed; no intubation or ICU procedure is recorded for any patient.
No figures or supplements are listed in the source.
